name: agents-learn-runtime-benchmarks
description:
Agents Learn Their Runtime -- Benchmark Traces
	

Paper: Agents Learn Their Runtime: Interpreter Persistence as Training-Time Semantics
1,200 inference traces from Qwen3-8B solving Opaque Knapsack tasks across 12 experimental conditions. The Opaque Knapsack is a partially observable constrained optimization problem where an agent must inspect items (hidden behind opaque IDs) to discover their weight, value, and class, then select a value-maximizing subset under capacity and budget… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/pythonformer/agents-learn-runtime-benchmarks.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate / average_return (utility-based performance on Opaque Knapsack tasks)
reputation: Experimental trace dataset released with a research paper; primarily of interest to researchers studying agent behavior and training-time semantics and not yet widely adopted.
